3/* This file was generated by the Octave script pythagorean_quadruples.
4 * It contains lists of pseudo-Pythagorean quadruples sorted by increasing
5 * distance from the origin. A pseudo-Pythagorean quadruple is a set of 4
6 * numbers A, B, C, R such that
7 * A * A + B * B + C * C = R * R

9 * Pythagorean quadruples force R to be an integer as well.) Note that
10 * the values below are stored as R*R, A, B, C so that all are integers.
11 */
